depthInterpretation: Authored dominant conditional ray-mode hypothesis. Select the strongest prior mode per image component and assign its complete projected weight there. Not a recovered gas depth; no duplicated secondary-mode feature or artificial bridge. Two-scale variant: smoothed image light is carried along the simulation's own density (envelope); finite components fit only the remaining detail. Envelope light and colour come from the calibrated DSS2 FITS composite; fine structure stays with the Horalek photograph.
